content:
Pebblebee has launched the LÔC8, a unique Android Find Hub/Apple Find My tracker designed to be hidden inside bike handles, golf clubs, and other places to help you keep tabs on your gear.

The LÔC8 is being sold alongside Pebblebee's various other trackers, but this one is specifically designed to be put in unexpected places. The cylindrical tracker is primarily aimed at bikes and golf clubs, but technically you can put it in any "tubular" object. However, it is clearly designed to be embedded rather than used standalone.

The LÔC8 has a clear plastic outer shell and is not designed to be exposed. But strictly speaking, if you just tossed it in a backpack or duffel bag pocket, it would also work, and should work well, because Pebblebee touts 3 years of battery life and "uncompromised performance." However, the caveat is that the battery has to stay in place, because it is exposed within the tubular structure.

That battery is not rechargeable, but it is replaceable. At least that's what Pebblebee says. From my initial research, the ER10250 battery seems hard to find online, so replacing it won't be as easy as swapping out a coin cell battery.

But overall, the experience is pretty simple — certainly easier than removing the grips from your bike handlebar (use WD-40, if you're curious).

There's a button on top of the tracker that you double-press to enable pairing mode. Then you just connect it via a nearby phone using Android Find Hub (or Find My on iPhone), and slide the tracker into your bike, club, or wherever you want to put it. There are two sleeves in the box to fit different bike handlebar sizes, though it's primarily mountain bikes for now. You can slide your regular grip over the top to cover the tracker. The battery lasts three years, and if the top of the tracker is still visible, you'll see an LED light up when you find it in the Find Hub app.

It's a simple idea with huge practical potential. Bike theft in cities is extremely common, and while it's not hard to add an AirTag-style tracker, a design like this makes it nearly impossible for a thief to remove. For golf clubs, on the other hand, there's no alternative to this. It's really nice to see such a clean solution come to fruition. Pebblebee shared this idea with us back in early 2025, and more are in the works, including a "puck" tracker that can be embedded into things like snowboards.

Pebblebee is selling the LÔC8 in 1-packs and 4-packs, with the former priced at $39.99 and primarily aimed at individual users as a DIY accessory to add to existing gear. The 4-pack is for golf club sets and requires professional installation.
